data.content_ref: inline:SRC_005 depends on SRC_002 via shared mechanism: the central-point concurrency claim and the observation that the k-th cut adds exactly 2 pieces both rely on the same diameter-splitting reasoning. SRC_005 generalizes the diameter recurrence into the 'all lines through a single point' form. This is refuted if SRC_005's mechanism can stand without the diameter-crossing logic of SRC_002.
